description.narrative: The overall objective is to support the establishment of a modernized VET system contributing to sustainable and inclusive socio-economic development. It allows a better economic governance, focusses on increased diversification and higher labour productivity. Improving the VET system will be achieved i.a. through the effective implementation of a reform action plan, an optimized VET network, improved attractiveness and quality of VET for both, male and female learners, and an increased relevance to the labour market.
